item.title: NY landlord banned after 16 children suffer lead poisoning in his properties
item.description: Due to alarming lead poisoning cases affecting minors, William D'Angelo has been compelled to sell his rental properties. His noncompliance with safety regulations has triggered serious intervention from state authorities. The Attorney General's Office has pinpointed numerous violations regarding unsafe lead paint situations. Future owners must obtain approval and quickly remediate any lead threats. D'Angelo is at risk of hefty fines and further legal issues if his violations persist.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Cameraman Wins $44,000: Salameh gives mother GTA 6 winnings; survives 60-minute robbery mission
item.description: MrBeast challenged his longtime cameraman, Tareq Salameh, to steal as much money as possible in GTA 6 within 60 minutes, promising real cash for every dollar earned. Despite losing his initial winnings after being killed, Salameh rebuilt his balance and completed a dramatic airport escape. He ultimately secured approximately $44,000 for his mother, turning the gaming challenge into an emotional surprise.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: Watch: Russian warship bursts into flames in suspected Ukraine drone attack in Libya
item.description: A suspected Ukrainian sea drone attack targeted a Russian warship at the Benghazi port, causing significant damage. Reports indicate that two drones successfully struck the corvette Merkury while it was docked to refuel. Libyan officials confirmed the incident and conducted an investigation into the attack's origin. Additionally, another drone attack occurred on a Malta-flagged commercial vessel off the coast.
item.dc:creator: Trisha Mahajan

item.title: Wife's support during husband's medical training becomes key in divorce asset battle
item.description: An Alabama appeals court reversed a divorce property settlement after finding that a lower court wrongly excluded a surgeon's medical-business interests, acquired during his marriage, from marital assets. His wife had supported the household while he completed medical training. The case has been sent back for a fresh valuation and division of the couple's property.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Could IShowSpeed have a future beyond YouTube? Usain Bolt weighs in after surprising 100m performance
item.description: In a thrilling showdown, IShowSpeed took on legendary sprinter Usain Bolt in a 100-meter race, finishing with a time of 10.352 seconds, as showcased in a captivating YouTube video on November 22, 2026. Although his achievement doesn't eclipse Bolt's remarkable world record, it certainly highlights Speed's untapped potential in sprinting. Bolt himself noted Speed's capability, igniting discussions about his possible future in the world of professional athletics.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: Kick streamer CostaKid sparks controversy after attacking woman in viral livestream clip
item.description: CostaKid, a 20-year-old streamer, has found himself at the center of controversy following a livestream incident. While broadcasting, a woman unexpectedly doused him with water, prompting an alarming reaction from CostaKid. His violent backlash included spitting, hair-pulling, and physical attacks. Onlookers urged him to cease his aggression, escalating the focus on his previous legal challenges and possible repercussions.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: Why did a small GTA 6 streamer break down in tears after Ibai Llanos joined his Twitch stream?
item.description: Dicrim_RD69 saw a remarkable surge in viewership after the popular streamer Ibai Llanos featured him during a GTA 6 livestream. What started as a nearly empty stream transformed into a bustling hub of activity, drawing in fans thanks to Ibai's influence. Overwhelmed with gratitude, Dicrim opened up about his earlier struggles in streaming, demonstrating how even a simple gesture of support can profoundly affect a creator's path.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: Welsh glamping-site owner faces £135,000 legal bill over disputed driveway
item.description: Carol Esteban, owner of a glamping site, is grappling with a hefty £135,000 legal bill stemming from a contentious boundary dispute with neighbors Neil and Nadine Gould. The court has granted the Goulds a right of way to their parking area, dismissing Esteban's claims. Currently, her legal team is appealing this decision, as the ruling's implications may significantly impact both the right of way and her financial obligations.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: A birdwatcher in Canada spotted a rare songbird absent from his county for over five years
item.description: In September, Canadian birdwatcher Paul Jones made a remarkable discovery in Ontario when he spotted an endangered loggerhead shrike. This bird, known for its striking appearance, had journeyed 30 miles from where it was released. This incident is pivotal for conservation initiatives focused on increasing the population of this declining species.
item.dc:creator: TOI Science Desk

item.title: A new snake found near the China-Nepal border looks like an earthworm
item.description: A new species of blind snake named Indotyphlops gyirongensis has been identified in Gyirong County, China. The specimen was found at a high elevation under a stone in August 2025. This snake is adapted to a life underground and has several unique physical traits. Researchers used both physical examination and genetic analysis to establish its distinct lineage. Further studies are needed to understand its distribution, population, and dietary habits.
item.dc:creator: TOI Science Desk

item.title: Illinois motorcyclist's $27.5 million verdict cut by $10 million on appeal
item.description: In a notable personal injury verdict, an Illinois motorcyclist was awarded $27.5 million for severe injuries sustained in a crash, only for the Fifth District Appellate Court to later trim the amount to $17.5 million. The court deemed the initial sum excessive, allowing the rider the choice to accept the lower amount or request a new trial, underscoring the significant effect appellate reviews can have on trial outcomes.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Warren Beatty and Annette Bening's LA mansion is up for sale for $14.9M
item.description: Listed at $14.995 million, this exquisite mansion boasts a rich Hollywood heritage, having been owned by the iconic Warren Beatty and Annette Bening for twenty years. The expansive 10,594 square foot estate features seven bedrooms, twelve bathrooms, and a swanky 17-seat theater named after Beatty himself. With modern finishes and a prime location that balances seclusion with easy access to Los Angeles, this property represents luxurious living at its finest.
item.dc:creator: TOI Real Estate Desk

item.title: Hershey's is bringing back its original five-cent chocolate bar price for one day on November 25, with limited offers through Walmart, Amazon and its own stores ahead of a film about the company's founder
item.description: To honor its rich heritage and usher in a new film, Hershey is bringing back its iconic five-cent chocolate bar for a limited time. This nostalgic initiative reflects Milton Hershey's dream of making chocolate readily available to everyone in America. Starting from November 25, fans can indulge in this sweet treat at select retailers like Walmart and Amazon.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Winter Gardens Restoration: Heritage Fund awards £10 million; reopening planned for December 2029
item.description: A £10 million grant is set to transform the People's Palace and Winter Gardens in Glasgow into a vibrant community hub. This initiative aims to enhance accessibility and create educational spaces that celebrate the city's rich history and culture. The project, anticipated to conclude by December 2029, will connect the glasshouse with the museum, ensuring a cohesive visitor experience while preserving these iconic landmarks.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Iowa court upholds will giving son 477 acres and daughters 107 each
item.description: In a complex case from Iowa, a 2003 will created significant disparities among an estate's four heirs, culminating in legal battles. After stumbling upon the will in 2014, the daughters sought resolution but were hindered by an unenforceable family agreement. The Iowa Supreme Court ultimately ruled that their contest was submitted after the allowable deadline, highlighting the critical importance of acting promptly when challenging wills to prevent similar estate disputes.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Warren Beatty and Annette Bening's former Beverly Hills home lists for $14.995 million
item.description: The iconic Beverly Hills residence of Warren Beatty and Annette Bening is now available for nearly 15 million dollars. Initially acquired for 6.7 million dollars in 2012, extensive renovations worth 5 million dollars have modernized its Mediterranean allure. Among its features are a custom home theater repurposed from the original office and a range of outdoor amenities, making it a perfect retreat steeped in cinematic history.
item.dc:creator: TOI Real Estate Desk
